name: africa-multiple-mcp-server
description: Read-only access to the Africa Multiple Cluster research data from the amira dashboard.
long_description:
Search and explore the research data of the Africa Multiple Cluster of Excellence, as published by the amira dashboard (https://amira.africamultiple.uni-bayreuth.de): research projects across four partner universities (Bayreuth, Lagos, Joseph Ki-Zerbo, Bahia) plus external collections, organised into thematic research sections, with ~4,000 digitised research items, people, institutions, groups, and an academic bibliography.

No API key, database, or VPN is required. A complete JSON snapshot (~16 MB) is bundled in the extension, so the server works fully offline. When enabled (default), it also refreshes itself from the dashboard's public JSON, and it contacts no backend database.

Every record carries a `dashboard_url` so results can be cited as links back to the source page.

tools.name: get_collection_overview
tools.description: High-level counts and breakdowns across the whole collection, plus snapshot freshness. Start here.

tools.name: search_research_items
tools.description: Search ~4,000 research items by keyword, subject, location, contributor, project, research section, university, resource type, genre, language, tag, and year.

tools.name: get_research_item
tools.description: Full metadata for one research item by its dre_id.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search the cluster's research projects by keyword, university, research section, PI, member, or institution.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full detail for one project, with item breakdown and top subjects.

tools.name: list_research_sections
tools.description: List the cluster's thematic research sections with PIs and counts.

tools.name: get_research_section
tools.description: Full detail for one research section, including its projects.

tools.name: search_persons
tools.description: Search the people authority list by name or affiliation.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Profile aggregating a person's projects led/joined, items contributed, and publications.

tools.name: get_institution
tools.description: One institution's affiliated projects and contributed items.

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: List LCSH subject headings ranked by item frequency.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List origin places (country/region/city) ranked by item count, with coordinates.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List values of a facet (tags, genres, languages, resource types) ranked by item count.

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Search the ~260-item cluster bibliography by keyword, author, type, or year.

tools.name: get_publication
tools.description: Full metadata and BibTeX for one publication.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Cross-entity discovery: pivot from a subject/location/person/project/tag to co-occurring entities.

live_refresh.title: Refresh data from the live dashboard
live_refresh.description: When on, the server checks the public amira dashboard for a newer data snapshot at startup and updates its local cache. Turn off to run fully offline using only the bundled snapshot. The server never connects to any database either way.

cache_dir.title: Refreshed-data cache directory
cache_dir.description: Where to store data refreshed from the dashboard. Leave default to use your home directory (~/.africa-multiple-mcp/cache).

dashboard_base.title: Dashboard base URL (advanced)
dashboard_base.description: Override the dashboard base URL used for citations and refresh. Defaults to https://amira.africamultiple.uni-bayreuth.de.
